title: OrchestratorFlow
description: An adaptive multi-agent automated code generation framework achieving an 88% task success rate, coordinating planning, coding, review, and test agents with Human-in-the-Loop validation.

title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Debate
description: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) framework where LLM agents with opposing reward signals debate, critique, and refine outputs, utilizing PPO with custom reward shaping to achieve consensus on complex tasks.

title: YoloDetector
description: A real-time object detection Android application powered by YOLOv8n / YOLO26n TFLite models, utilizing high-performance CameraX pipelines and a custom sci-fi themed UI overlay.

title: YOLO Custom Trainer
description: An end-to-end deep learning pipeline for annotating custom data (using Label Studio), training custom object detection models with Ultralytics YOLOv8, and deploying inference bots.

title: MoodifyAI
description: An emotion-aware AI application exploring how conversational interaction, music preference, and user signals can be combined into a more adaptive intelligent system.

title: PaperMind AI
description: A document intelligence project for asking grounded questions over PDFs, reflecting my interest in retrieval, language understanding, and research-oriented reading workflows.

title: AIDesktopAssistant
description: A local AI assistant using TinyLLaMA for voice-driven productivity, built to explore lightweight model behavior, agentic workflows, and practical human-computer interaction.

title: Password Manager System
description: A security-focused software project that strengthened my systems thinking, backend discipline, and understanding of trustworthy application design.
